t: Comrade Lienhard Alias Karl Shultz, German Communist

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
No. D 4411
SECTION Political Dept
Date January 24, 1933
Subject (in full) Comrade Lienhard alias Karl Schultz, German Communist.
Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by O.F.G. Lumeret
With reference to the report dated January 12, 1933, on
the subject of comrade Lienhard(File 4411), it is reported that the
real name of this individual is Karl Schultz and that he is at
present in Germany. Schultz is a member of the German Communist
Party and a member of the Prussian Diet.
It is also reported that while he was in China during
1925-1927 he worked under the instructions of Willy Munzenberg
( File D.3956 ) and founded the Chinese branch of the " Workers
International Relief".
G. Prokofiev
D.S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
(批：SR)
(批：Reg. Please let me know if
he is mentioned in any old
files. I think we had inquiries

日期 1933年1月24日
事由（全称） 连哈德同志，别名卡尔·舒尔茨，德国共产党人。
制作人 D.S.普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人 O.F.G. 卢默雷特
关于1933年1月12日有关连哈德同志（档案4411号）的报告，现报告称，此人的真名为卡尔·舒尔茨，目前身在德国。舒尔茨是德国共产党党员，也是普鲁士邦议会议员。
另据报告，他在1925年至1927年期间在华时，是在威利·明岑贝格（Willy Munzenberg）（档案 D.3956 号）的指示下工作，并创立了“国际工人救济会”的中国分会。
G. 普罗科菲耶夫
D.S.
特别股主管警官。
（批注：SR）
（批注：登记室。请告知我他是否在任何旧档案中被提及。我想我们以前曾就一名叫连哈德的人进行过查询。
OFG

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. BY REGISTRY.
HH11
SECTION 2 SUBDIV 13/1/23
Date January 12, 1933

REPORT

Subject (in full) Comrade Lienhard

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special
Branch dated January 5, 1933 on the subject of comrade Lienhard
who, according to an article published in the " China Digest" of
October 22, 1932 ( page 158 ) was the predecessor of comrade
Ruegg and passed unmolested all through China and Japan openly
flouting his I.A.H. ( Workers International Relief ) credentials,
in 1927. I have to state that Lienhard's name is mentioned in
the Municipal Police records on two occasions:-

1. An account published in the " Canton Gazette" of July 11, 1925
on the " Popular Mass Meeting at Peking on June 30, 1925, Pro-
testing Against Shameen Shakee Massacre" contains the follow-
ing passage:-

" German Labour Leader
" Federich Lienhard who also attended the meeting, representing
the International Labour Unions, said in his speech that the
workmen of the world will fight together against their com-
mon enemies, Imperialism and Capitalism. He would wire Lon-
don and elsewhere and tell the actual conditions of the
Chinese to the labouring brethren in other lands"
( I.O. File No 6380 ).

2. A certain Lienhard was among the passengers who left
Shanghai for Vladivostok on board the s.s. " Haitan" on
August 11, 1927. ( I.O. File No 8343)

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

[Signature]
Officer i/c Special Branch

部门 2科 13分部 1/23
日期 1933年1月12日

报告

事由（全称） 连哈德同志

制作人 D.S.普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人 [签名]

关于特别股主管警官于1933年1月5日就连哈德同志一事所发的备忘录，据1932年10月22日出版的《中国文摘》（China Digest）（第158页）上的一篇文章称，他是吕格（Ruegg）同志的前任，并于1927年公然蔑视其国际工人救济会（I.A.H.）的证件，畅通无阻地穿越中国和日本。兹陈述如下：连哈德的名字在工部局警务处档案中出现过两次：-

1. 1925年7月11日《广州公报》（Canton Gazette）刊登的关于“1925年6月30日北京抗议沙面夏基大屠杀的群众大会”的报道中，包含以下段落：-

“德国劳工领袖
“联邦里希·连哈德（Federich Lienhard）也出席了会议，代表国际工会联合会，他在演讲中说，全世界的工人将联合起来对抗他们的共同敌人，即帝国主义和资本主义。他将致电伦敦及其他地方，向中国境外的劳工兄弟通报中国的实际情况”
（情报办公室档案号 6380）。

2. 某位连哈德是1927年8月11日乘坐“海坛”号轮船（s.s. "Haitan"）离开上海前往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的乘客之一。（情报办公室档案号 8343）

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
D.S.

[签名]
特别股主管警官
